text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh my... Look at me.
I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I was up late sewing...
I just got completely carried away...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...I feel like giving someone a big hug.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you come over here
for just a moment~?

Super Creek swayed slightly with sleepy eyes.
It seemed she didn't get much rest.
